orphan_works: Exception for relevant bodies using orphan works in their collections (s. 70A; orphan works defined in Reg. 4 of S.I. 490/2014)
digital_protection: Offence to make or sell protection-defeating devices or assist circumvention of rights protection measures (s. 140(4))
fair_use_exceptions: Fair dealing exceptions: research or private study, criticism or review, parody, caricature or pastiche (ss. 50-51)
registration_required: No (the Act has no works register; its registers cover licensing bodies)
